title: a16z Podcast: Modernizing Government Services, From Food Stamps to Foster Care

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: When people think of modernizing government, they tend to think of new IT, of improved procurement, of new infrastructure ...
reader_summary.overview: When people think of modernizing government, they tend to think of new IT, of improved procurement, of new infrastructure ... rather than social services like foster care or food stamps. But how can we actually help improve daily lives -- less in the abstract and more concretely -- by applying tools and lessons from consumer tech to help put food on the table.

key_points.text: But how can we actually help improve daily lives -- less in the abstract and more concretely -- by applying tools and lessons from consumer tech to help put food on the table.
In this episode of the a16z Podcast, recorded from Capitol Hill in Washington D.C.
